info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Knowledge Assets Intellectual Property Portfolios-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Knowledge Assets Portfolio API allows users to access a comprehensive list of intellectual property portfolios related to banking knowledge assets. This API serves financial institutions, inventors, and researchers looking to leverage valuable banking insights for innovation and strategic development. By retrieving detailed information about intellectual property holdings, users can identify opportunities for collaboration, investment, or knowledge acquisition in the banking sector. The API supports various use cases ranging from R&D evaluation to competitive analysis, enabling effective decision-making in the context of banking innovations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive information about the intellectual property portfolio, including key assets, their statuses, and related documentation, facilitating a deeper understanding of the organization's intellectual properties.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to retrieve information related to the intellectual property portfolio, including details about specific assets, their status, and associated metadata.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the intellectual property portfolio details are returned.

ListBankingKnowledgeAssetsIntellectualPr.description: This schema represents the request body for getting information about the intellectual property portfolio.
